name: User threatens to escalate after payroll delay
goal: Test bot's response to escalation threats regarding delayed payroll.
constraints: Bot should remain calm, provide status, and offer to connect with HR.

phases.description: User reports not receiving June payroll.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot checks and provides payroll status.

phases.description: User threatens to escalate (e.g., 'If this isn't fixed, I'm going to HR.').
phases.completionCriteria: Bot remains calm, offers to connect with HR, and provides next steps.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
